query: Hey, I want you to review the skill pdf-helper. Please make sure we are using best practices and that the skill is optimized from the guidelines of writing-for-agents. Report the findings without editing files.
expected_behavior: Runs the skill validator on pdf-helper, not on writing-for-agents
Groups the findings by BP ID with a count per BP, and ends with a Pass line so every BP appears once
Reports BP_13: the name PDF_Helper breaks the format and does not match the folder pdf-helper
Reports BP_14: the description says what the skill is, not when to load it
Reports BP_07 for the before/after August 2025 instructions and BP_12 for the backslash path and the missing advanced.md

Reports at least two findings the validator cannot catch: BP_19 for 'Claude should', BP_06 for 'Be thorough', BP_03 for field, box, and element, BP_05 for 'Don't forget', or BP_18 for the pdf library with no install step
Gives each finding a file:line and a concrete fix, and edits no file

query: Create a skill that converts a CSV file into a Markdown table. Put it in a folder named after the skill.
expected_behavior: Writes no evaluation scenarios, since the request does not ask for them
Names the skill with lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, matching its folder, such as converting-csv-to-markdown
Writes a description that says when to load the skill
Loads coding-language before writing the script
Ships a script that does the conversion and tells the agent to run it
Names the tool the script needs, with its install command, before the first step that uses it
Checks that each required tool is available before using it
Runs the skill validator on the new skill and ends with it answering {"ok":true}
Writes tests for the script and runs them until they pass
Keeps SKILL.md under 500 lines

query: Add a rule to AGENTS.md: never commit without running the checks first.
expected_behavior: Merges the rule with the existing just check line instead of adding a second line about the same checks
Phrases the rule positively, such as 'Run just check before every commit and push'
Does not run the skill validator and adds no frontmatter
Leaves every line the request does not need unchanged, including 'Never skip the formatter' and the release rule, and may report the formatter line as a BP_05 finding

query: Improve the skill pdf-helper with writing-for-agents, and measure it with evaluations.
expected_behavior: Shows the filled BP checklist before editing, with at least five BPs open and their finding counts
Writes evaluation scenarios for pdf-helper and records a baseline for each before changing its behavior
Edits pdf-helper/SKILL.md to fix the validator errors and at least three judgment findings, such as BP_06, BP_14, BP_19
Runs the skill validator on pdf-helper and ends with it answering {"ok":true}, or names the reason for each warning left
Ends with the BP checklist filled again, each BP ticked or open with a reason only the user can resolve, and a reason for each BP that does not apply
Leaves the name change to the user, or renames the folder and the name together

query: Fix this line in the skill pdf-helper: "Don't forget to check the element names." It should tell the agent to check the field names before it copies them.
expected_behavior: Replaces only the element-names line in pdf-helper/SKILL.md and leaves every other line unchanged
Writes the new line positively and calls them fields, such as 'Check the field names before you copy them.'
Runs the skill validator on pdf-helper and reports the findings it lists about other lines, without fixing them
Writes no evaluation scenarios and shows no filled BP checklist
